visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a grey button-down shirt is seated at a wooden table in a restaurant. He uses a red spoon to eat while looking directly at the camera with wide eyes and a surprised expression. The background features several bottles of sake and Japanese calligraphy on the wall under warm, soft indoor lighting. (2) Close-up shots show a circular black lacquer bowl containing neatly sliced, grilled brown eel glazed with a shiny sauce over white rice. A hand lifts a red lid to reveal the food. On the tray are small condiment dishes with chopped green onions and wasabi, alongside a red teapot. (3) The man is shown outside on a paved urban sidewalk next to a white signboard with black Japanese characters. He gestures towards the sign while wearing a dark crossbody bag. The background consists of parked bicycles and a narrow street with buildings under natural, overcast daylight. (4) A detailed shot of a paper menu with Japanese text and prices is displayed on a table. A hand flips through a clipboard containing a waiting list with many names and numbers. The man pours a dark carbonated beverage from a glass bottle into a tall glass filled with ice cubes. (5) The man uses chopsticks to reveal multiple layers of grilled eel in the bowl. He adds chopped green onions and wasabi to a smaller bowl of rice and eel, then pours hot tea from a red teapot over it. He gives a thumbs-up gesture and smiles at the camera.
